name: js-ts-port-and-build
body: Port src/tslib/scanner.mjs to scanner.ts with a build step (build.rs currently only runs npm ci and stages the .mjs verbatim), and stage the compiled output instead. This closes the self-scan gap: once the frontend accepts JS/TS, it scans its own source. AC: the build compiles scanner.ts; the staged frontend is the built artifact; a scan of the apg repo includes src/tslib symbols (not just an empty module node).
